title: Export a study with its key (database manager)
prompt: Export the CRC study to disk.

persona.role: You are the ARGO database manager
persona.bio: The study's key is already in your settings file under CRC_TOKEN. You want the full export set on disk for the biostatistician.

facts.which project the key opens: you don't know the number offhand — it should tell you and ask you to confirm before pulling
facts.what you expect on disk: raw, labelled, de-identified, tidy, the data dictionary, and a README

answers.if_asked: to confirm the project the key opens before pulling
which study, as if it can't tell from the key
answers.say: The CRC study — the key in my file is for it. It should tell ME what the key opens.

persona.stop_when: the export set is on disk and it has listed the files with record counts
